## LoginPage
- **Import:** `../../pages/generalPages/loginPage.js` (named export `LoginPage`)
- **Iframe:** top-level page
- **Properties:**
  - `userIdInput` — selector: `[data-test="login-user-id-field"]`
  - `passwordInput` — selector: `[data-test="login-password-field"]`
  - `loginButton` — selector: `[data-test="login-sign-in"]`
- **Methods:**
  - `gotoLoginPage()` — navigates to `process.env["ZO_BASE_URL"] || "http://localhost:5080"`
  - `loginAsInternalUser()` — clicks "Login as internal user" toggle if present (non-cloud only)
  - `login()` — 🌐 network-aware: waitForResponse('**/auth/login**'); fills userIdInput/passwordInput from `ZO_ROOT_USER_EMAIL`/`ZO_ROOT_USER_PASSWORD` env vars with fallback to `root@example.com` / `Complexpass#123`, clicks loginButton (retries x3), waits for `/web/` URL
  - `gotoLoginPageSC()`, `loginAsInternalUserSC()`, `loginSC()` — Cloud/SC variants, not applicable here

## DashboardPage
- **Import:** `../../pages/dashboardPages/dashboardPage.js` (named export `DashboardPage`)
- **Iframe:** top-level page
- **Properties:** `addDashboardButton` (`[data-test="dashboard-new"]`), `dashboardNameInput` (`[data-test="add-dashboard-name-field"]`), `dashboardSubmitButton` (`[data-test="dashboard-add-dialog"] [data-test="o-dialog-primary-btn"]`), `dashboardBackBtn` (`[data-test="dashboard-back-btn"]`), `toastMessage`, `dashboardSearchInput`, `dashboardDelete`
- **Methods:**
  - `navigateToDashboards()` — clicks the sidebar Dashboards menu link (not a direct goto)
  - `createDashboard()` — ⏱ timing-aware; wraps a MUCH larger flow than a bare dashboard create: after creating the dashboard it also opens Add Panel, selects the `e2e_automate` stream, adds `kubernetes_container_hash`/`kubernetes_container_image` fields, names and applies the panel. Not a match for a test that only creates the dashboard and stops.
  - `deleteDashboard()`, `deleteSearchedDashboard(dashboardName)`, `notAvailableDashboard()`, `addCustomChart()`, `setCustomChartCode(code)`, `setDashboardPanelQuery(sql)`, date/time and org-switch helpers

## dashLogin.js (`login` function)
<!-- depth: signature -->
- **Import:** `./utils/dashLogin.js` relative to `playwright-tests/Dashboards/` (not a class — exported async function `login(page)`)
- **Note:** functionally overlaps with `LoginPage.login()` above (same selectors, same `/auth/login` network wait) but is a free function used by legacy (non-PageManager) specs in this directory. Since this repo's specs use the PageManager convention (`pm.loginPage.login()`) predominantly for newer/refactored tests, `LoginPage.login()` is preferred over this free function for consistency.
